answer: Canyon sparrow heartbeat bond: each identity posts one sparrow on a canyon rim, locking 70 credits. A violet beacon flashes randomly; the sparrow has 10 minutes to fly a work-hash heartbeat across the canyon. Auditors check time and hash on the echo table; late or copied ones burn it. Filing: 33 first, 33+6(k-1) per k-th; 1,000 fakes pay 3,030,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented sparrows fail: one bird cannot carry two; honest agents pay 33 once.
